Adapters or instances the send_to tool m: Adapters or instances the send_to tool may send messages to, separated by commas; * allows all. Empty: no send_to tool.
Add and delete instances and upgrade ada: Add and delete instances and upgrade adapters from the repository (add_instance, delete_instance, upgrade_adapter tools). Off by default.
Allow MCP clients to create/modify objec: Allow MCP clients to create/modify objects, aliases and scenes and to write files (set_object, create_alias, write_file tools). Off by default.
Allow MCP clients to write state values: Allow MCP clients to write state values and to acknowledge system notifications (set_state, set_states, clear_notifications tools)
As a web extension the selected web inst: As a web extension the selected web instance provides the login: OAuth must be enabled there as well ('Allow third-party clients'), otherwise MCP clients only get a redirect to the login page, which they cannot use.
Ask for confirmation before dangerous ac: Ask for confirmation before dangerous actions
Create, change, start/stop and delete sc: Create, change, start/stop and delete scripts of the javascript adapter and run code once (set_script, enable_script, delete_script, run_script tools). Reading scripts is always allowed. Off by default.
Declare set_state/set_states as destruct: Declare set_state/set_states as destructive (destructiveHint), so MCP clients can warn before writing. Whether a client still asks for confirmation when this is off depends on the client.
Without authentication, all MCP requests: Without authentication, all MCP requests run with the permissions of this user (e.g. 'admin')
Enable 'Authentication' first — without: Enable 'Authentication' first — without it the MCP endpoint is open and OAuth has nothing to protect.
Enable ioBroker user authentication for: Enable ioBroker user authentication for the web server
Enter an address like https://iobroker.e: Enter an address like https://iobroker.example.com - scheme and host only, no path
Externally reachable address of this ser: Externally reachable address of this server, without a path. Required behind a reverse proxy. As a web extension it must match the public URL of the web instance.
For data that is too large for an MCP me: For data that is too large for an MCP message, e.g. a long list of objects or a .tgz to install, tools hand out links valid for 15 minutes, which clients that can run shell commands (e.g. Claude Code) use with curl. Not available as a web extension with authentication enabled in the web adapter.
IP address to bind the server to (0.0.0.0 for all interfaces)
MCP clients register themselves automati: MCP clients register themselves automatically. With this off, every client has to be registered by hand before it can connect.
MCP clients such as Claude Desktop conne: MCP clients such as Claude Desktop connect through a browser login instead of a token you create by hand. The client never sees the ioBroker password and discovers the server on its own.
MCP clients that support it (elicitation: MCP clients that support it (elicitation) ask the user before an object or instance is deleted, an instance stopped, an adapter upgraded or installed, a script saved or run, or a message sent. Other clients rely on their own confirmation.
OAuth without HTTPS: remote MCP clients: OAuth without HTTPS: remote MCP clients refuse plain http:// and will not be able to connect. Enable SSL, or put this server behind an https reverse proxy and set the public URL.
Only relevant for adapter developers: MC: Only relevant for adapter developers: MCP clients may install adapter packages (npm, GitHub, URL or .tgz file) on an ioBroker host (install_package tool). Off by default.
Path to the chained certificate file (op: Path to the chained certificate file (optional)
Path to the private key file: Path to the private key file
Path to the public certificate file: Path to the public certificate file
Port on which the web server will listen: Port on which the web server will listen
Scripts run with full access to ioBroker: Scripts run with full access to ioBroker. Only enable this for MCP clients you trust.
Start, stop and restart adapter instance: Start, stop and restart adapter instances and change their log level (start_instance, stop_instance, restart_instance, set_log_level tools). Off by default.
This option is meant for developing adap: This option is meant for developing adapters on a test system, e.g. to let an AI agent install a freshly packed .tgz. An installed package runs with full rights on the host. Never enable it on a productive system or for clients you do not fully trust.
